description: Checks that a URL is well-formed, normalizes it (lowercase host, punycode, default ports removed, spaces encoded) and splits it into parts including each query parameter. Flags common problems such as missing scheme, private/localhost addresses and credentials embedded in the URL. Does not fetch the URL.

require_https.description: Treat http:// as invalid. Default false.

name: validate_url
title: Validate and normalize a URL
